newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Elliott steps down from top job at CEPA.
newsitem.headline: Elliott steps down from top job at CEPA.

text.p: Stewart Elliott has resigned as chief executive of Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd (CEPA), which was taken over by U.S. power producer Southern Energy Inc earlier this year, Southern Energy said on Friday.
Elliott, would return to a senior managment position with Hopewell Holdings Ltd, where he is a director, Southern Energy said in a statement.
It said Raymond Hill, Southern Energy's chief financial officer, would take the job of CEPA chief executive.
Southern Energy, a subsidiary of Southern Co, paid US$2.7 billion in January for majority ownership of CEPA, previously controlled by Hopewell Holdings.
